instr: Cube nets: pick the flat pattern that folds into the cube shown.
clue: The cube has a different mark on each of its six faces; you see three of them. Each flat pattern below can be folded into a cube, with the marks on the outside. Only one of them makes exactly this cube: the same marks, next to each other in the same way and pointing the same way. Click or tap that pattern, or press its number key 1 to 4. Press Start when ready.
options: Which pattern folds into this cube?
